name: Guardian Angel
overview: Scripture reveals that God appoints angels as ministering spirits sent to protect, guide, and strengthen His people. These guardian angels watch over believers, as seen in Exodus 23:20 where an angel is sent ahead to lead and protect, and in Psalms 34:7 where the angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him to deliver them. Jesus affirms the special care given to believers, noting that their angels behold the Father's face in heaven (Matthew 18:10). Angels also provide strength in times of trial (Luke 22:43) and are recognized as personal protectors (Acts 12:15), emphasizing their role in the salvation and care of God's heirs (Hebrews 1:14).
